title: Dutch Tofu Skewers
description: A flavorful and colorful dish with a mix of textures, inspired by Dutch cuisine. Perfect for a quick and easy dinner.

ingredients.name: fresh herbs (such as parsley or cilantro)

instructions: 1. Preheat grill or grill pan to medium-high heat.
3. Thread the tofu, crispy onions, and fresh herbs onto the skewers.
4. Brush the skewers with olive oil and season with Dutch seasoning blend.
5. Grill the skewers for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally.
6. While the skewers are grilling, mix together honey and soy sauce in a small bowl.
7. After the skewers are cooked, brush them with the honey-soy sauce mixture.
8. Serve hot with lemon wedges on the side.
9. Garnish with additional fresh herbs if desired.
